titulo.pt: 17. Um carro com Vehicle e o Vehicle Lab
titulo.en: 17. A car with Vehicle and the Vehicle Lab
titulo.es: 17. Un coche con Vehicle y el Vehicle Lab

resumo.pt: Chão, chassi Rigid Body, 4 rodas No Collision, aba Vehicle, Add Vehicle Component e Vehicle Lab.
resumo.en: Ground, Rigid Body chassis, 4 No Collision wheels, Vehicle tab, Add Vehicle Component and Vehicle Lab.
resumo.es: Suelo, chasis Rigid Body, 4 ruedas No Collision, pestaña Vehicle, Add Vehicle Component y Vehicle Lab.

abertura.pt: Vamos montar um carro simples com o cubo e quatro rodas, e ajustar ele com o jogo rodando.
abertura.en: Let's build a simple car from the cube and four wheels, and tune it while the game runs.
abertura.es: Vamos a armar un coche simple con el cubo y cuatro ruedas, y ajustarlo con el juego en marcha.

encerramento.pt: Pronto: o carro anda e você ajusta motor e suspensão ao vivo no Vehicle Lab.
encerramento.en: Done: the car drives and you tune engine and suspension live in the Vehicle Lab.
encerramento.es: Listo: el coche anda y ajustas motor y suspensión en vivo en el Vehicle Lab.

texto.pt: Salve o arquivo (Ctrl+S): o script do carro fica ao lado do .range.
texto.en: Save the file (Ctrl+S): the car script goes next to the .range.
texto.es: Guarda el archivo (Ctrl+S): el script del coche queda junto al .range.

texto.pt: Faça o chão: Add › Mesh › Plane. Depois S, 30, Enter e G, Z, -2, Enter.
texto.en: Make the ground: Add › Mesh › Plane. Then S, 30, Enter and G, Z, -2, Enter.
texto.es: Haz el suelo: Add › Mesh › Plane. Después S, 30, Enter y G, Z, -2, Enter.

checagem.expr: any(o.type == 'MESH' and o.dimensions.x >= 20 and o.location.z < -1 for o in C.scene.objects)

texto.pt: Clique no cubo (o chassi) e, no Properties, abra a aba Physics.
texto.en: Click the cube (the chassis) and, in Properties, open the Physics tab.
texto.es: Haz clic en el cubo (el chasis) y, en Properties, abre la pestaña Physics.

checagem.expr: C.active_object is not None and C.active_object.select and C.active_object.type == 'MESH' and C.active_object.dimensions.x < 5 and any(a.spaces.active.context == 'PHYSICS' for a in C.screen.areas if a.type == 'PROPERTIES')

texto.pt: Troque Physics Type para Rigid Body.
texto.en: Change Physics Type to Rigid Body.
texto.es: Cambia Physics Type a Rigid Body.

checagem.expr: C.active_object is not None and C.active_object.select and C.active_object.type == 'MESH' and C.active_object.dimensions.x < 5 and C.active_object.game.physics_type == 'RIGID_BODY'

texto.pt: Abra a aba Vehicle e marque Enabled.
texto.en: Open the Vehicle tab and check Enabled.
texto.es: Abre la pestaña Vehicle y marca Enabled.

texto.pt: Faça uma roda: Add › Mesh › Cylinder. Depois R, Y, 90, Enter e S, 0.3, Enter.
texto.en: Make a wheel: Add › Mesh › Cylinder. Then R, Y, 90, Enter and S, 0.3, Enter.
texto.es: Haz una rueda: Add › Mesh › Cylinder. Después R, Y, 90, Enter y S, 0.3, Enter.

checagem.expr: C.active_object is not None and (lambda o: o.type == 'MESH' and abs(abs(o.rotation_euler.y) - 1.5708) < 0.1 and max(o.dimensions) < 0.8)(C.active_object)

dica.pt: A roda fica de pé, com 0,3 m de raio: o mesmo Radius da roda no Vehicle.
dica.en: The wheel stands up with a 0.3 m radius: the same Radius as the wheel in Vehicle.
dica.es: La rueda queda de pie, con 0,3 m de radio: el mismo Radius de la rueda en Vehicle.

texto.pt: Na aba Physics, troque Physics Type para No Collision: a roda não pode bater no chassi.
texto.en: In the Physics tab, change Physics Type to No Collision: the wheel must not hit the chassis.
texto.es: En la pestaña Physics, cambia Physics Type a No Collision: la rueda no puede chocar con el chasis.

checagem.expr: C.active_object is not None and (lambda o: o.type == 'MESH' and abs(abs(o.rotation_euler.y) - 1.5708) < 0.1 and max(o.dimensions) < 0.8)(C.active_object) and C.active_object.game.physics_type == 'NO_COLLISION'

texto.pt: Aperte N e, em Location, escreva X 1.2, Y 1 e Z -0.8: a roda da frente, à direita.
texto.en: Press N and, in Location, type X 1.2, Y 1 and Z -0.8: the front right wheel.
texto.es: Presiona N y, en Location, escribe X 1.2, Y 1 y Z -0.8: la rueda delantera derecha.

checagem.expr: C.active_object is not None and (lambda o: o.type == 'MESH' and abs(abs(o.rotation_euler.y) - 1.5708) < 0.1 and max(o.dimensions) < 0.8)(C.active_object) and C.active_object.location.x > 0.8 and C.active_object.location.y > 0.5

dica.pt: A frente do carro é o Y positivo.
dica.en: The front of the car is positive Y.
dica.es: El frente del coche es la Y positiva.

texto.pt: Faça as outras 3 rodas com Shift+D e ponha cada uma num canto (X 1.2 ou -1.2, Y 1 ou -1).
texto.en: Make the other 3 wheels with Shift+D and put each in a corner (X 1.2 or -1.2, Y 1 or -1).
texto.es: Haz las otras 3 ruedas con Shift+D y pon cada una en una esquina (X 1.2 o -1.2, Y 1 o -1).

checagem.expr: len({(o.location.x > 0, o.location.y > 0) for o in C.scene.objects if o.type == 'MESH' and abs(abs(o.rotation_euler.y) - 1.5708) < 0.1 and max(o.dimensions) < 0.8 and o.game.physics_type == 'NO_COLLISION' and abs(o.location.x) > 0.8 and abs(o.location.y) > 0.5}) == 4

dica.pt: Shift+D, X, -2.4, Enter leva a cópia direto para o outro lado.
dica.en: Shift+D, X, -2.4, Enter takes the copy straight to the other side.
dica.es: Shift+D, X, -2.4, Enter lleva la copia directo al otro lado.

texto.pt: Clique no cubo de novo, abra a aba Vehicle e clique 4 vezes em Add Wheel.
texto.en: Click the cube again, open the Vehicle tab and click Add Wheel 4 times.
texto.es: Haz clic en el cubo otra vez, abre la pestaña Vehicle y haz clic 4 veces en Add Wheel.

checagem.expr: any(o.game.is_vehicle and len(o.vehicle_wheels) >= 4 for o in C.scene.objects)

texto.pt: Em Wheel 1 até Wheel 4, escolha um cilindro diferente em cada.
texto.en: In Wheel 1 to Wheel 4, pick a different cylinder in each.
texto.es: En Wheel 1 a Wheel 4, elige un cilindro distinto en cada una.

checagem.expr: any(o.game.is_vehicle and len(o.vehicle_wheels) >= 4 and all(w.object is not None for w in o.vehicle_wheels) and len({w.object.name for w in o.vehicle_wheels}) == len(o.vehicle_wheels) for o in C.scene.objects)

texto.pt: Nas duas rodas da frente (Y 1), ligue Steering: elas viram o carro.
texto.en: On the two front wheels (Y 1), turn on Steering: they turn the car.
texto.es: En las dos ruedas delanteras (Y 1), activa Steering: ellas giran el coche.

checagem.expr: any(o.game.is_vehicle and any(w.has_steering for w in o.vehicle_wheels) for o in C.scene.objects)

texto.pt: Em Engine › Drive Type, clique em AWD: as 4 rodas puxam o carro.
texto.en: In Engine › Drive Type, click AWD: all 4 wheels pull the car.
texto.es: En Engine › Drive Type, haz clic en AWD: las 4 ruedas tiran del coche.

checagem.expr: any(o.game.is_vehicle and len(o.vehicle_wheels) > 0 and all(w.has_drive for w in o.vehicle_wheels) for o in C.scene.objects)

texto.pt: Em Player Component, clique em Add Vehicle Component: são os controles do carro.
texto.en: In Player Component, click Add Vehicle Component: these are the car controls.
texto.es: En Player Component, haz clic en Add Vehicle Component: son los controles del coche.

checagem.expr: any(o.game.is_vehicle and any(c.name == 'VehiclePlayerComponent' for c in o.game.components) for o in C.scene.objects)

texto.pt: Aperte P: W acelera, S dá ré, A e D viram, Space freia. Esc sai. Depois, clique em Next.
texto.en: Press P: W speeds up, S reverses, A and D steer, Space brakes. Esc quits. Then click Next.
texto.es: Presiona P: W acelera, S da reversa, A y D giran, Space frena. Esc sale. Después, haz clic en Next.

dica.pt: A vista não segue o carro: afaste a 3D View antes (rodinha do mouse).
dica.en: The view does not follow the car: zoom the 3D View out first (mouse wheel).
dica.es: La vista no sigue al coche: aleja la 3D View antes (rueda del ratón).

texto.pt: No menu Game › Debug, ligue Debug Mode.
texto.en: In the Game › Debug menu, turn on Debug Mode.
texto.es: En el menú Game › Debug, activa Debug Mode.

texto.pt: Aperte P de novo. Na janela Options, marque Vehicle Lab e mude motor, marchas e suspensão com o carro andando. Depois, clique em Next.
texto.en: Press P again. In the Options window, check Vehicle Lab and change engine, gears and suspension while the car drives. Then click Next.
texto.es: Presiona P otra vez. En la ventana Options, marca Vehicle Lab y cambia motor, marchas y suspensión con el coche andando. Después, haz clic en Next.

dica.pt: Se o mouse não aparecer, aperte F1.
dica.en: If the mouse does not show up, press F1.
dica.es: Si el ratón no aparece, presiona F1.
